description: Defines the 'channel_state_information' class for managing various channel state measurements such as SINR, EVM, RSRP, CFO, and time alignment within the 'ocudu' namespace. Includes methods for setting, getting, and processing these measurements, with references to related headers and external functions.

classes.name: channel_state_information
classes.description: Manages optional channel measurement data such as SINR, EVM, RSRP, CFO, and time alignment, with methods for setting, retrieving, and processing these metrics.

methods.name: sinr_type_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding SINR type enum.

methods.name: get_sinr_dB
methods.description: Returns the SINR value in dB based on the current report type.

methods.name: set_sinr_dB
methods.description: Sets the SINR measurement in dB for a specified SINR type.

methods.name: set_total_evm
methods.description: Sets the total Error Vector Magnitude (EVM).

methods.name: get_total_evm
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total EVM, combining per-symbol EVMs if necessary.

methods.name: set_symbol_evm
methods.description: Sets the EVM for a specific OFDM symbol index.

methods.name: get_symbol_evm
methods.description: Returns a span of per-symbol EVM measurements.

methods.name: set_epre
methods.description: Sets the Energy Per Resource Element (EPRE) in dB.

methods.name: set_rsrp_lin
methods.description: Sets RSRP per antenna port in linear units and computes the average RSRP.

methods.name: set_cfo
methods.description: Sets the Carrier Frequency Offset in Hz.

methods.name: get_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Retrieves the CFO measurement in Hz.
